messages.author: fc5d3270037d7478
messages.subject: StanCon 2017 submissions deadline is today!
parts:
Hi all, 

This is a final reminder that the deadline for submissions (not registration) to StanCon is today. For details see http://mc-stan.org/events/stancon-submissions.html. 

For those of you who have already submitted, we will send you an email over the next few days confirming receipt of your submission and letting you know if we encounter any technical issues when running any of your code. 

- StanCon Organizers
